# mdv sample

A paragraph with a [link](https://example.com) and `inline code`.

## Settings

| Flag | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-w` | int | terminal width | wrap width in columns |
| `-theme` | path | desktop theme | a colors.toml to use instead |
| `-palette` | bool | false | print the resolved palette and exit |

> Quoted text with **bold** inside.
